newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on lower turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday as A shares fell to $109 from Tuesday's $110 and B shares rose to $114.125 from $114.
Turnover in Solidere shares was 4,959 shares from 7,831 on Tuesday and value was $548,545.625 from $872,134.
Also traded on the BSE were 10,500 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.1562. A block of 70,000 Ciments Libanais shares were traded a day earlier over the counter at $1.20.
There was no trade in the shares of the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.50 percent to 81.36 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.72 percent to 934.96.
